title: Type product pitch: individual, team, and company agent memory layers
summary: Type advertises a hosted company brain with separate memory scopes for individuals, teams, and the whole company that improves as people work, as a UX reference for partitioning agent context.
question_it_answers: How does a commercial product partition personal, team, and company memory for agents?

claims.text: Type builds distinct memory layers at individual, team, and company levels.
claims.evidence: Type builds a separate memory on the individual, team and company level.
claims.subject: agent-memory-knowledge

claims.text: type.com 200 / 651,313 B titles “Type | A shared workspace for Claude and Codex.” First-party: share work from individual Claude or ChatGPT conversations into a central space; “Build a shared company brain: context, memory and skills that constantly self-improve”; “Builds memories and learns as your team works.” Tweet’s three-layer individual/team/company schema is not a numbered product architecture in the HTML.
claims.subject: agent-memory-knowledge
